.qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r8/task/tests/** (prompts, judge.toml, app_context.md, .dockerignore, Dockerfile COPY lines) for overlap comparison
evidence: Static: task/environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template Dockerfile (26 lines); its only COPYs are `COPY instructions/ /instructions/` (line 14) and `COPY assets/ /assets/` (line 15); /app is created, git-initialised and given only .gitkeep (lines 17-23). The environment/ build context holds only Dockerfile, assets/seed_data.json and three instruction notes; no solution/ or tests/ copy. seed_data.json (identical to solution/app/seed/seed_data.json) contains only input state (accounts, matters, timers, walls, messages with stored versions/holds, read_up_to positions) and no derived outputs (no expected unread counts, no pre-expired list, no schema, routes or UI). Grep of brief+notes+seed for judge|rubric|criteri|dimension|reward|weight|score.py|playwright|claude|glm|/tests|sentinel|probe|golden|solution found nothing. A token n-gram comparison of brief+notes against every tests/**/*.md and *.toml found no 12-token overlap; at 8 tokens only three short hits: the account table in tests/app_context.md (public account facts) and two short requirement phrases in functional/judge.toml quoting conversations.md ('shows a short preview of the linked message', 'type @ in the message box the app suggests') - criteria echoing the public ask, not notes reproducing criterion text. Functional criteria name no seed K-ids. Runtime (Docker 29.7.2, built frozen environment/ as qc-r8-row16-env:tmp, then removed with docker rmi; container ran --rm): /app contains only .git and empty .gitkeep (one commit 'Initialize task workspace', 1 file); /solution, /tests, /oracle absent; find for server.js/app.js/solve.sh/judge.toml/*.db/transcript.css outside node_modules returned nothing; files mentioning 'kittle' outside /usr are only /assets/seed_data.json and /instructions/walls-and-retention.md; in-image SHA256 of seed_data.json (b256f85e...) and the three notes (b27d0b5c..., 492e5833..., bbdd40a2...) match the frozen sources. Adversarial: a stub app cannot gain credit from leaked material because there is no starter, skeleton or answer copy to ship; a conforming alternative is not constrained by any provided scaffold. Scope: this row reviewed environment leak only; it is not evidence of verifier, Oracle or model scores.
